alternatives_considered: Open RFP to other RCM platforms
battlecards.why_selected: Met Treya benchmark target of 3.15 % fee while avoiding $9 M early-termination penalty and disruptive platform change
battlecards.contract_terms: Addendum executed Q3-2022; 3-year price lock at 3.15 % of collections, retroactive to 9/1/22; early-termination language unchanged
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Benchmark data showed current rates out-of-market; client threatened RFP and downgrade to Collector; looming 2025 expiry created window for mid-term reset
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Deep integration with existing workflows, high switching costs, ability to scale with Advantia growth
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Originally uncompetitive pricing, rigid contract language, large termination penalty
battlecards.switching_costs: $9 M penalty, provider retraining, data migration risk
battlecards.notes: Savings scenario analysis demonstrated 4-14 % potential depending on volume; final 7-9 % captured at current volume.

battlecards.why_selected: Provided lowest total cost in BAFO, agreed to 60-day payment terms, committed dedicated implementation resources
battlecards.contract_terms: Prime-vendor agreement, 3 years with QBRs, formulary compliance, 60-day net terms
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Consolidation of fragmented spend across two regions and commitment to enterprise volume
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Broad catalog, strong analytics & inventory programs, favorable payment terms
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Transition effort required for Heartland practices; some Medline private-label items need cross-reference
battlecards.switching_costs: System integration, staff retraining, SKU conversion
battlecards.notes: Mid-Atlantic kept existing McKesson relationship; Heartland migrated from Medline by 10/31/22.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pricing above market in both rounds; could not meet Advantia service & payment-term requests
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of consolidation and competitive pricing pressure
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher pricing, less flexible payment terms, limited enterprise reporting
battlecards.notes: Remains secondary back-up for certain SKUs if McKesson stockouts occur.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Could not match cost of blended in-house model; non-responsive during negotiation
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: High market bill rate vs salaried employee cost; option to self-provide service
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Turn-key staffing model with minimal management
battlecards.switching_costs: Recruiting & onboarding internal sonographers, equipment scheduling
battlecards.notes: Last invoice rate $50/scan; contract scheduled to wind down by EOY 2022.

battlecards.why_selected: Provides flexible recruiting capacity (20 % utilization) complementing internal team while still delivering >18 % savings overall
battlecards.contract_terms: On-demand recruiting contract; pay-as-used with mark-up built into hourly bill rate
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Low guaranteed volume; multiple staffing agencies available
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Access to sonography talent pipeline, scalable support
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Adds mark-up cost vs direct hire; requires management coordination
battlecards.switching_costs: Low—no minimum term, easy to shift spend
battlecards.notes: Model assumes 80 % in-house hires, 20 % Staffmark placements.

battlecards.why_selected: Operational fit and LIS integration outweighed incremental savings from Quest; agreed to 9 % price reduction
battlecards.contract_terms: Revised pricing effective 11/1/22; 12-month price hold; option to revisit in 2023
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest BAFO 19 % savings offer created price pressure
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Existing phlebotomist staffing, LIS already integrated with Athena
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher pricing vs Quest, limited rural courier coverage
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-interfacing systems, retraining staff, patient disruption
battlecards.notes: Treya recommends revisiting supplier mix after operational process review in 2023.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Change deemed operationally disruptive despite higher savings; implementation risk outweighed benefit
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Aggressive BAFO pricing used to pressure incumbent
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Lowest cost proposal (19 % decrease), strong courier network
battlecards.switching_costs: Interface build with Athena, contract termination costs with LabCorp, practice workflow changes
battlecards.notes: Remain viable alternative for future rebid if LabCorp performance falters.

summary.skipped_reason: Manufacturers in IUD categories and office-supply vendors were skipped due to behavioral-change focus or basic spend data only
